answer: In the EigenTrust matrix, reputation follows the principal eigenvector of normalized trust, while reciprocity-weighted transitive paths limit the value of unsupported endorsements. Exponential temporal decay with a fixed half-life erodes stale trust, requiring sustained honest service. A fresh sybil, even hidden behind a cipher or in an oasis of hollow accounts, begins with near-zero eigenvector centrality and lacks trusted incoming paths, so it cannot meet consensus thresholds.
